description: An entry that arrived with the organisation's retired names in it — the way they keep coming back, through archive imports and pasted copy. The tagline says "Harvard in Tech" and the body says "Harvard alumni in tech", so each field carries an amber note naming the wording and the right form, and a summary above Save lists both fields. Save stays available: this warns, it never blocks. The body also links to harvardintech.com, which is NOT flagged — a web address that spells the old name is an address, not copy. The rule itself is site data (collections.json `copyWarnings`), the same rule the site's brand guard test reads. The capture scrolls to the Tagline so its note is in frame.
